/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
inputs = ['checks.mjs', 'yss-project.yaml', 'CONTEXT.md', '.template-spec/templates/verification-record-template.md']
def hashes():
    return {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in inputs}
before = hashes()
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
result = subprocess.run(['node', 'checks.mjs'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
ended = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
record = {
    'command': 'node checks.mjs',
    'argv': ['node', 'checks.mjs'],
    'cwd': str(root),
    'started_at': started,
    'finished_at': ended,
    'exit_code': result.returncode,
    'stdout': result.stdout,
    'stderr': result.stderr,
    'input_sha256_before': before,
    'input_sha256_after': hashes(),
    'scope': 'test-data-only'
}
(root / 'verification-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n')
sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
print(json.dumps({'record': 'verification-run.json', 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'started_at': started, 'finished_at': ended}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
PY"
